downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.searchDisabledPlaceholder: Install yt-dlp in settings to search for tracks
downloads.depsInstallText: yt-dlp is required to search and download tracks. Install it on the settings page.
downloads.depsUpdateText: An update is available for the download components. Update them on the settings page to improve stability.
downloads.depsDenoText: yt-dlp is installed, but the Deno JS engine is missing — it's required for reliable YouTube downloads. Install it on the settings page.
downloads.depsRecommendText: Without ffmpeg only ready-made audio is downloaded. Install it for the best quality on the settings page.
downloads.depsBotwallText: YouTube asked to confirm you're not a bot. Sign in on the settings page and try again — sign-in is optional and only needed when this happens.

deps.title: Download components
deps.desc: yt-dlp, ffmpeg and the Deno JS engine — needed to search and download tracks. They are installed, updated and removed together.
deps.updateTooltip: Will be updated to newer versions: {list}

cookies.desc: Authorization is necessary to improve the stability of downloading external tracks via yt-dlp (optional)
cookies.searchDisabledPlaceholder: Sign in to YouTube in settings to download tracks
cookies.statusValid: Authorization completed — download stability is improved
cookies.bannerLogin: Finish signing in to YouTube in the opened window…
cookies.bannerSelect: Sign in to YouTube — required to bypass the bot wall and download tracks. Do it on the settings page.
cookies.bannerInvalid: Your saved YouTube session didn't pass validation (it may have expired). Sign in again on the settings page.

comp.ytdlpDesc: Required to search and download tracks. The Deno JS engine is installed alongside it for reliable YouTube extraction.
comp.ffmpegDesc: Recommended: conversion to supported formats and better quality
comp.denoMissing: Installed, but the Deno JS engine is missing — required for YouTube
comp.deleteTooltip: Removes only the dependencies installed by the app.
comp.installAllHint: Install everything needed for downloads (yt-dlp, ffmpeg and the Deno JS engine) in one step.
comp.confirmText: The executable "{name}" will be downloaded from {source}. Only download if you trust the source.
comp.confirmAllText: yt-dlp, ffmpeg and Deno will be downloaded from their official repositories. Only continue if you trust the sources.
comp.confirmUpdateText: The components with a newer version will be re-downloaded from their official repositories and replace the current versions. Only continue if you trust the sources.

downloads.idleDesc: Type a track or artist name. Tracks found in external sources can be downloaded in the best available quality — they will be added to your library.
